purpose: Define the professional first-page information architecture, visual shell, scientific-boundary rules and machine-checkable status sources for the Romanian Monetary Dynamics repository, while preserving suite consistency with AtM, EWD and CBD without forcing paradigm uniformity.

evidence_basis.rule: README must explain what the project does, why it is useful, how to get started, where to get help and who maintains it; detailed material should be delegated.
Use reader-needs ordering, scannability, inverted-pyramid structure and progressive disclosure.
Expose statement of need, installation/reproduction path, usage/verification, tests, support and citation/release practice.
Make software identity, versioning, provenance and reuse-relevant metadata explicit.
Expose model structure transparently while delegating equation-level details, units and source information to navigable detailed documentation.
Separate overview/getting-started from mathematical specification, tutorials, reproducibility and developer documentation.

header_primary_badges_order: Scientific CI or project build health
shared_visual_tokens.tagline: one centered sentence; small text permitted
shared_visual_tokens.body_typography: normal GitHub Markdown size; small text reserved for metadata, notes and navigation

shared_scientific_model_section_order: What is established and not established
Reproduce or verify the scientific baseline
suite_consistency.non_uniformity_rule: The common shell and navigation grammar must not force EWD, CBD and RMD into the same scientific paradigm. Model-specific structure/status blocks must reflect the canonical paradigm of each repository.

rmd_specific_identity.plain_language_purpose: RMD models how financial stocks, transactions and financing relationships evolve across the Romanian economy under explicit accounting constraints.
rmd_specific_identity.technical_identity: An accounting-constrained empirical stock-flow-consistent dynamic model core of Romania's monetary and macro-financial system, under development toward an endogenous System Dynamics reference model.
rmd_specific_identity.canonical_paradigm_boundary: Accounting / stock-flow core plus observed reference modes plus candidate feedback architecture. Behavioural closure is inactive and RMD must not be presented as a complete endogenous System Dynamics model.
primary_audiences: developers inspecting the scientific model core

sectors: F — Financial corporations excluding BNR when shown separately
instruments: F5 — Equity and investment fund shares/units
F6 — Insurance, pensions and standardised guarantees
F7 — Financial derivatives and employee stock options

must_show: one-sentence purpose understandable without SFC/SD jargon
one explicit sentence that RMD is a scientific model core rather than an end-user application
must_not_show: large status tables before the overview

first_page_sections.goal: Explain problem, purpose, audience and technical identity in two levels: plain language first, technical definition second.
Expose sectors, F2-F8 instrument scope, accounting constraint and dynamic maturity without showing the full 6x6x7 accounting matrix.
first_page_sections.visual_rule: Prefer one compact conceptual figure or compact table. No decorative banner.

first_page_sections.goal: Make the distinction Accounting Spine -> observed evidence/reference modes -> candidate dynamics -> validation/activation gates immediately visible.
first_page_sections.required_warning: Candidate behavioural structures are not quantitatively active merely because they exist in a registry.

first_page_sections.goal: Render the canonical baseline as a compact status table sourced from machine-readable registries.
Summarize four topologically closed candidate loops and one open candidate chain without implying activation.
Separate established capabilities/evidence from explicit non-claims.
required_non_claims: not a complete endogenous System Dynamics model
no automatic inference of missing/TBD values

first_page_sections.goal: Provide the shortest faithful local path corresponding to Scientific CI and explain what PASS verifies and does not verify.
Explain source-vintage -> processed data -> evidence/artifact -> validation flow and the core data-integrity rules.
hard_rules: partial/component evidence is not canonical completion
aggregate evidence is not a bilateral allocation
provider/access failure is not negative scientific evidence

first_page_sections.goal: Route readers to model/accounting, model/dynamics, model/empirical_dynamics, model/calibration_validation, model/registries, data/source_vintages, data/processed, scripts, tests and releases.
Route reader intent: understand model, exact status, reproduce, inspect provenance, inspect contracts, cite, frozen release.

readme_consistency_gate.rule: README current-state values must be automatically checked against canonical registries in Scientific CI. A stale public status must fail CI rather than silently diverge.
readme_consistency_gate.version_rule: README release/version metadata remains governed by model/registries/release_versioning_contract.json.

target_reading_layers: 30 seconds: identity, purpose, boundary, current state
5 minutes: structure, evidence, dynamic candidates, reproduction
deep dive: canonical registry and STATUS links

approval_boundary.reason: The professional landing page is implemented on a review branch with promoted public assets and CI checks, but publication on main remains gated by review of the complete rendered page.

benchmark_repository_patterns.adopted_pattern: Clear one-paragraph purpose and audience, then concise features/documentation/installation/usage/support/citation routing.
benchmark_repository_patterns.not_adopted: Large badge wall and framework-centric feature catalogue, because RMD is a single scientific model core with a stricter scientific-status boundary.

benchmark_repository_patterns.adopted_pattern: Keep the repository landing page high-level and route mathematical specification, tutorials and detailed methodology to dedicated documentation.
benchmark_repository_patterns.not_adopted: Framework/API emphasis that would obscure RMD's accounting and evidence boundaries.

benchmark_repository_patterns.adopted_pattern: Explain early why the project exists and what gap it addresses.
benchmark_repository_patterns.not_adopted: Presenting RMD primarily as a simulation engine; RMD is a scientific model core.

benchmark_repository_patterns.adopted_pattern: Make verification concrete by stating an expected reproducible outcome rather than only listing installation steps.
benchmark_repository_patterns.not_adopted: Policy-analysis claims that exceed RMD's current validated boundary.

benchmark_repository_patterns.adopted_pattern: Route readers with different goals and levels of expertise to the appropriate entry point.
benchmark_repository_patterns.not_adopted: Long introductory/tutorial material on the repository landing page.
